supporting_role: near-nozzle methane forcing and mixing boundary evidence

target_questions.question: Does the methane jet exhibit a shock-dominated near-nozzle zone distinct from a downstream momentum-conserving zone?
target_questions.target_basis: Tier 1 B004 identifies a structured near field; this experiment measures force and impulse rather than only optical geometry.

evidence_candidates.claim_text: The measured high-pressure methane jet separates into a near-nozzle shock-affected zone with force/impulse fluctuations and negligible entrainment, followed by a downstream zone with weaker shock influence and conserved impulse.
evidence_candidates.evidence_summary: Impact-force, impulse, and mass-flow measurements identify two spatial regimes relevant to injector placement and ignition avoidance.

core_links.shared_parameter_or_mechanism: near-field shock structure and mixing boundary

limitations: Single-hole methane injector and force-based zone definition; not directly equivalent to hydrogen optical-zone metrics.
visual_verification: Targeted visual verification performed where numeric/glyph-dependent abstract claims required it; no figure digitization.
